children.game_version: Play as a 'follow the leader' game in a circle.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the entire sequence while seated in a chair.
seniors.standing_version: Perform standing with support if balance is an issue.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Percussive hand movements including slaps, claps, and fist pounding.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Minimal movement; torso remains relatively stable.
movement_profile.partnering: Facing a partner, but no physical contact required.
movement_profile.posture: Slightly hunched over, bent knee position.

signature_moves.description: Making fists with thumbs extended and pointing them over the shoulder.
signature_moves.name: Hitchhike

music_profile.musical_form: 12-bar blues or standard pop song structure
music_profile.sound_description: A driving, syncopated rhythm characterized by the Bo Diddley beat, which provides a clear, percussive pulse for hand movements.

basic_steps: Crouch slightly and slap thighs twice.
Pound fists on top of each other twice.
Touch elbows one at a time.
teaching.formation: Standing, facing a partner or in a line.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner level; requires coordination of hand-eye movements.
teaching.rhythm: Steady rhythm, each move falling directly on the beat.
